name: Five in a Row
goal: Make five of your stones in a row before your rival.
howToWin: Take turns placing one stone. Five or more in an unbroken line, across, down or diagonally, wins. If the board fills up, it is a draw.
ruleVariant: Free-style Five in a Row (Gomoku): five or more in a row wins, Black moves first, no forbidden moves. Optional Fair start lets the second player swap sides after the first stone. Boards 9x9, 13x13 and 15x15.
about: Five in a Row, also called Gomoku, is a traditional game played with stones on a grid of lines.
